parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail
SENTRIX="{{ $json.SentrixBarcode || $json.sentrix_id }}"
IDAT_DIR="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/$SENTRIX"
QC_TXT="$IDAT_DIR/${SENTRIX}_qc.txt"
if [ ! -f "$QC_TXT" ]; then
  echo ""
  exit 0
fi
cat "$QC_TXT"
BASH_SCRIPT

parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'::text AS sentrix_id,
        '{{ $json.position }}'::text AS position,
        '{{ $json.sex_estimate }}'::text AS sex_estimate,
        '{{ $json.gtc_file_path }}'::text AS gtc_file_path,

        'GSACyto_20044998_A1.bpm'::text AS bpm_name,
        'GSACyto_20044998_A1.csv'::text AS csv_name,
        'cluster2027.egt'::text AS egt_name
),
scan_ref AS (
    SELECT
        s.uniqueref AS scan_ref,
        s.sentrix_id
    FROM scans s
    JOIN params p
      ON s.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
),
concept_refs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.bpm_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS bpm_concept_ref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.csv_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS csv_concept_ref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.egt_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS egt_concept_ref
    FROM concepts c
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE c.concept_name IN (p.bpm_name, p.csv_name, p.egt_name)
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE idats i
    SET
        gtc_file_path = p.gtc_file_path,
        estimated_gender = NULLIF(p.sex_estimate, ''),
        manifest_bpm_concept_ref = cr.bpm_concept_ref,
        manifest_csv_concept_ref = cr.csv_concept_ref,
        cluster_file_concept_ref = cr.egt_concept_ref,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM params p
    JOIN scan_ref sr ON sr.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
    CROSS JOIN concept_refs cr
    WHERE i.scan_ref = sr.scan_ref
      AND i.position = p.position
      AND cr.bpm_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.csv_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.egt_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING i.uniqueref
)
SELECT
    sr.scan_ref,
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    p.gtc_file_path,
    cr.bpm_concept_ref,
    cr.csv_concept_ref,
    cr.egt_concept_ref,
    COUNT(u.uniqueref) AS updated_idat_count
FROM params p
LEFT JOIN scan_ref sr ON sr.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
CROSS JOIN concept_refs cr
LEFT JOIN updated u ON TRUE
GROUP BY
    sr.scan_ref,
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    p.gtc_file_path,
    cr.bpm_concept_ref,
    cr.csv_concept_ref,
    cr.egt_concept_ref;

parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
TMP_ROOT="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/.tmp_dragena"

if [ -d "$TMP_ROOT" ]; then
  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
  echo "{\"status\":\"tmp_root_deleted\",\"tmp_root\":\"$TMP_ROOT\"}"
else
  echo "{\"status\":\"tmp_root_not_found\",\"tmp_root\":\"$TMP_ROOT\"}"
fi
BASH_SCRIPT

=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail

SENTRIX="{{ $json.sentrix_id }}"
QC_DIR="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/.tmp_dragena/$SENTRIX/qc_report"

QC_XLSX=$(ls -t "$QC_DIR"/DRAGENArray_QC_table_*.xlsx 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)

if [ -z "$QC_XLSX" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"qc_xlsx_missing\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"qc_dir_server\":\"$QC_DIR\"}"
  exit 1
fi

N8N_QC_XLSX=$(echo "$QC_XLSX" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')

echo "{\"status\":\"qc_xlsx_found\",\"sentrix_id\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"qc_xlsx\":\"$N8N_QC_XLSX\",\"qc_xlsx_server\":\"$QC_XLSX\"}"
BASH_SCRIPT

parameters.query:
SELECT i.uniqueref, s.sentrix_id AS sentrix_id, i.position AS position
FROM idats i
JOIN scans s ON s.uniqueref = i.scan_ref
WHERE s.sentrix_id = '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'
AND i.position = '{{ $json.position }}'
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO data_operations_array
  (idat_ref, recipe_ref, status_concept_ref, created_at)
VALUES
  ({{ $json.idat_ref }}, 489, 24, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (idat_ref, recipe_ref)
DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING uniqueref, idat_ref;

INSERT INTO measurement_idats
  (measurement_concept_ref, value_as_number, data_operations_ref)
SELECT
  c.uniqueref,
  (r.value)::double precision,
  ($1::jsonb->>'data_operations_ref')::bigint
FROM jsonb_each_text($1::jsonb) AS r(key, value)
JOIN concepts c ON c.concept_name = r.key
WHERE c.uniqueref BETWEEN 496 AND 544
  AND r.value IS NOT NULL
  AND btrim(r.value) <> ''
  AND r.value ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$'
ON CONFLICT (data_operations_ref, measurement_concept_ref)
DO UPDATE SET value_as_number = EXCLUDED.value_as_number;

UPDATE data_operations_array
SET status_concept_ref = 29,
    performed_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE uniqueref = {{ $json.data_operations_ref }}
  AND recipe_ref = 489
  AND status_concept_ref = 24;

UPDATE idats i
SET
  qc_status = CASE
    WHEN m.acr > 0.98 AND m.lrd < 0.2 THEN 'PASS'::qc_status_enum
    ELSE 'FAIL'::qc_status_enum
  END,
  qc_tag = CASE
    WHEN m.acr > 0.98 AND m.lrd < 0.2 THEN NULL
    ELSE ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY[
      CASE WHEN m.acr IS NULL OR m.acr <= 0.98 THEN 'AutosomalCallRate' END,
      CASE WHEN m.lrd IS NULL OR m.lrd >= 0.2  THEN 'LogRDev' END
    ], NULL)
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
FROM (
  SELECT
    doa.idat_ref,
    MAX(m.value_as_number) FILTER (WHERE c.concept_name = 'AutosomalCallRate') AS acr,
    MAX(m.value_as_number) FILTER (WHERE c.concept_name = 'LogRDev')           AS lrd
  FROM measurement_idats m
  JOIN data_operations_array doa ON doa.uniqueref = m.data_operations_ref
  JOIN concepts c ON c.uniqueref = m.measurement_concept_ref
  WHERE doa.idat_ref = {{ $json.idat_ref }}
    AND c.concept_name IN ('AutosomalCallRate', 'LogRDev')
  GROUP BY doa.idat_ref
) m
WHERE m.idat_ref = i.uniqueref;
